itemDisplayName: Create an Azure Local cluster with iSCSI SAN storage
description: This ARM template validates and deploys an Active Directory domain-joined Azure Local cluster with external iSCSI SAN storage, per-node iSCSI networking, and optional CHAP authentication backed by Azure Key Vault.
summary: Validate and deploy an Azure Local cluster with external iSCSI SAN storage, per-node networking, and optional CHAP authentication.
